title: He Carried Our Sorrows
traveler_why: Willow is the Traveler who sits with people in the sad, and tonight is Isaiah's Man of sorrows carrying ours: she does not fix her brother's dropped ice cream or hurry him along, she sits down on the warm cement and holds his hand.
traveler_about: Willow fits tonight because carrying someone else’s sadness is the tenderest kind of love. In Willow’s world today: her little brother dropped his ice cream on the sidewalk and could not stop crying. Willow sat down beside him on the warm cement. She did not fix it or hurry him along; she just held his hand. Just like Jesus, who carried our sorrows, Willow learned that love sits with people in the sad.
